title: Chapter 287 Taking In Ye Tianba
content:
Chapter 287 Taking In Ye Tianba

At this time, he no longer had the high spirits he had in Changping County. He was a man who valued friendship and loyalty. After this disaster, he was filled with grief and indignation. He wanted to kill the army of undead and avenge his dead brothers.

Ye Tianba stopped when he saw Wang Shuo did not leave with him.

"Mayor Wang, hurry up. A single undead knight is already very powerful, and there are more than a hundred of them." Ye Tianba said hurriedly with an anxious look in his eyes.

Wang Shuo was relieved when he heard this and immediately ordered: "Prepare for battle."

Thousands of hell three-headed dogs appeared out of thin air, which was spectacular.

Ye Tianba was stunned when he saw the soldier just now, quickly turned over and climbed onto the back of the three-headed dog.

His mind was buzzing.

Wang Shuo ignored him because the undead knights of the Burning Legion had already appeared in his sight.

Wang Shuo took out the Bloodthirsty Spear, pointed the spear, and the Knights of Hell rushed towards the undead knights.

Although the level of the Undead Knight is very high, the lowest level is 50, but the individual strength is not much stronger than the Hell Three-Headed Dog Knight.

Wang Shuo's soldiers are generally of A-level qualifications, and the territory also has an additional attack qualification, so the ace troops can be said to be S-level.

Each level provides 6 attribute points, which is more than the attribute points Wang Shuo gets after upgrading.

The combat power is naturally very strong.

When the two sides fought, the number of Undead Knights was crushed, and they were naturally beaten without any ability to fight back.

It can almost reach 10 to 1.

Ten people attack in one round, killing an Undead Knight is more than enough, after all, the attack of the three-headed dog is not covered.

One round of charge, ending the battle, clean and neat.

For such battles, I don’t know how many times they have been staged in the past two days, and Wang Shuo didn’t take it to heart at all.

But Ye Tianba and his only three remaining brothers couldn’t believe the facts in front of them.

They rubbed their eyes and felt that they must have fallen into an illusion.

Fantasy before death?

Wang Shuo returned and jumped off Da Huang's back.

"Brother Tianba? Are you okay?"

Ye Tianba came back to his senses.

"Wang, Mayor Wang, you, what kind of troops are these?" Ye Tianba was a little slurred.

Wang Shuo patted Da Huang's head and said with a smile: "This is my mount, the three-headed hellhound. How about it, mighty and domineering, ah, haha!"

Ye Tianba drooled.

Da Huang and the three-headed hellhounds, who had inherited the position of the leader of the three-headed hellhounds, were naturally very strong.

Of course, the other adult three-headed hellhounds were only a little smaller than their king in terms of size.

But there was still a big gap in attributes, endurance, attack power, etc.

Ye Tianba saw Wang Shuo's three-headed hellhound knight troops and couldn't take his eyes off them.

He imagined that if he could command such a unit, he would be invincible on the battlefield and kill all enemies.

He thought about it and decided that since he didn't plan to be a lord anymore, it would be a good choice to join Wang Shuo.

So, he knelt on one knee and said to Wang Shuo: "Mayor Wang, my Tianba Town no longer exists, and I have nowhere to go now. Please take me in."

At this time, the three people behind him also knelt down.

Wang Shuo was delighted and readily agreed to help him up.

At the same time, he checked Ye Tianba's information.
